main_stone.evidence: 吊坠表面呈现密集的小颗粒状反光，无法确认为钻石，故描述为透明晶石

design.structure: 细链条连接四叶草造型吊坠，吊坠由四个心形叶片组成花朵形状
design.shape_and_proportion: 吊坠呈圆形轮廓的四叶草形态，比例适中，链条纤细

generation.subject_description_en: A silver-tone necklace with a four-leaf clover pendant, featuring dense pave setting of clear crystals on the petals and a delicate chain.
generation.wearing_instruction_en: Wear around the neck, letting the four-leaf clover pendant rest centrally on the chest.
generation.macro_focus_en: Close-up view highlighting the intricate pave crystal setting on each petal of the clover pendant and the fine link chain structure.
generation.gift_presentation_en: The necklace displayed elegantly on a soft, neutral-colored jewelry stand or velvet cushion, emphasizing its sparkle.
forbidden_additions_en: No colored metals like gold or rose gold
